snapshot.text: Underfunded public system with large gaps for the rural and Indigenous population. The health ministry's focus is rebuilding the hospital network, primary care and an evidence-based 2026 spending plan.

priorities.title: Rebuilding the health network
priorities.text: The minister prioritises recovering the health network.

priorities.title: Primary care
priorities.text: At WHA79 the minister promoted primary care, community development and disease control.
